text:
taylor-partners: Quick heads-up: Vector Integrations is ready to pilot co-sell next week. Need to lock lead ownership, attribution window, and a small "lead escrow" flow for disputed handoffs. Can we align today?

ben-sales: Sounds good. My baseline: SI-sourced = SI gets first-touch credit; Redwood owns product-sourced. For overlap, propose an escrow tag for 10 days while we qualify.

riley-salesops: I can implement escrow as SFDC status 'PartnerEscrow' + a custom field partner_source. Want standardized field list so automation is bulletproof.

nina-vector: From Vector: they want visibility for deals they introduced and a rapid escalation path if we lose track. Also request a partner-facing dashboard for lead status.

zara-legal: Two quick notes: (1) Need to update the partner addendum to capture escrow and credit formulas; (2) announcements require joint comms signoff 5 business days out.

taylor-partners: Draft RoE (short):
- Attribution: tag as `vector-intro` if Vector contact pre-dates our first outreach in CRM
- Escrow: set status `PartnerEscrow` for 10 calendar days on conflicting leads; resolved by Rep ownership or SRM adjudication
- SFDC fields: partner_source, partner_tag, partner_escrow_until, partner_credits
- Announcements: PM + legal + partner approve any co-branded content 5 business days before publish

ben-sales: Can we include a simple credit split table? e.g., intro only = 20% credit; sourced+closed by SI = 100% to SI; joint motion = negotiated split.

riley-salesops: I'll add automation: when partner_source == "Vector" AND first_touch == "partner" set partner_tag=vector-intro and route to queue `vector-co-sell`. Also auto-set partner_escrow_until = today + 10d if conflict detected. Example rule:

```
IF (lead.partner_source == "Vector" AND lead.first_touch != "Redwood") THEN
  lead.partner_tag = "vector-intro";
  assignToQueue("vector-co-sell");
ENDIF

IF (lead.hasExistingOwner AND lead.partner_tag != NULL) THEN
  lead.status = "PartnerEscrow";
  lead.partner_escrow_until = date_add(today,10);
ENDIF
```

nina-vector: Dashboard ask: Vector needs read access to lead status only. Is there a partner view we can expose?

taylor-partners: We have a partner portal. Will provision RBAC read-only for Vector for the pilot. Riley, can you prepare a CSV schema so Vector can bulk upload contacts?

riley-salesops: CSV schema below, includes partner fields:

```
account_name,account_id,partner_source,partner_contact,first_touch_date,partner_type,notes
Acme Plc,ACM-9001,Vector,s.jones@vector.com,2026-02-28,SI,"introduced at conference"
```

zara-legal: Also include a quick opt-in template for customer demos. If a customer is in a regulated sector we need an opt-in signed. I'll draft a one-paragraph consent.

triage-bot: partner-portal.redwood.com/vector created, invite sent to partner-admin@vector.com

taylor-partners: Next steps checklist: 1) Riley implements SFDC fields + escrow workflow; 2) Legal drafts addendum + demo opt-in; 3) Taylor to publish partner portal invite & dashboard; 4) Sales to block demo infra week of trade show.

ben-sales: Slack sync Thu 11:30 to confirm. I'll bring a sample co-sell opp for the pilot.

nina-vector: Vector confirmed Thu 11:30. We'll bring contact list and our preferred credit calc.

taylor-partners: Great. I'll circulate the RoE doc after this thread and drop calendar invite. :white_check_mark:
